'''G9-RX''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|Battle droid]] produced at some point before the [[war against Zakuul]]. By [[3630 BBY]] it was used by [[Dust Vipers]] gang based on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. When the [[Eternal Alliance]] forces attacked the [[Dust Viper Den]] to reclaim the stolen plans for the [[Alliance base]], Dust Viper [[Bel Nerodia]] confronted them alongside [[G9-RX]], but after intense fight Nerodia was killed and G9-RX destroyed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
G9-RX appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during the final boss fight of the "Done and Dusted" Uprising.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
